rappel_detail.anchor: fixed cord and webbing at the top of the falls; inspect it
rappel_detail.station: The top of the Waterfall 3 chockstone and boulder jam in the south gully.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional: most parties downclimb this step facing in on climber's left. Some rappel it, especially when wet or with a less experienced group. A second station is sometimes found at the smaller waterfall below.
hazards: Loose, sandy-mud rock and small holds.

set.rappel_count_note: One or two rappels at Waterfall 3, all optional: the main one from the anchor at the top of the falls, and sometimes a second from a station at the smaller waterfall below. Most parties downclimb.
